name: Pyramid · Hall of Pillars
_design: Mummy Pyramid zone (level-designer 2026-11-17; Boss: mummies live ONLY here; finished to the goblin camp's level 2026-11-17). Generated by tools/maps/build_mummy_pyramid.gd (edit the script, not this file): Pillared hall on a floating island: a dark stone hall wall (north, east, west; open cliff in front) with a colonnade and architrave along the back, a gold-framed doorway between the middle columns, side colonnades with Anubis statues, square pylon towers in the back corners, lapis and teal banners, torches and braziers; a fallen column and drums lie on the front margin. The board is dark polished slabs framed by a teal-and-gold inlay with a red-ochre runner down the middle. Cover: two broken column stumps on the monster side. Monster ids/levels here are a fixture: the real waves come from data/journeys/mummy_waves.json and take the spots in list order (melee, knights, then the ranged ones).
_arena: Board 16 x 9 m like the goblin boards. Cover: 2 low blocks (1.5-1.6 m: too high to jump on, low enough to see over) on the monster side; they stop projectiles both ways (logic/projectiles.gd) and the ranged monsters step aside for a clear line (logic/enemy_ai.gd). The middle and the squad's half stay open (logic/auto_pilot.gd walks straight at its target).
_spots: Spot roles in order: melee, melee, melee, melee, knight, knight, archer, mage
